newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Kirch confirms discussing large loan.
newsitem.headline: German Kirch confirms discussing large loan.

text.p: Germany's Kirch Group on Monday confirmed it was discussing a large loan with Bavarian state-owned bank Landesanstalt fuer Aufbaufinanzierung (LfA).

The bank had earlier said it was to provide several hundred million marks in credit for Kirch and that other banks were also involved in the credit line, which has been estimated at some one billion marks in total.
Kirch refused to comment on the size of the credit line or on what the money would be used for.
Its spokesman merely said it was usual for companies to finance their activities through loans.
Munich-based industry sources said the funding would be used to finance films rather than Kirch's DF1 cable television network which is though to be running into high start-up costs.
Kirch has been under pressure to find a partner for DF1 since British Sky Broadcasting (BSkyB) pulled out of plans to invest in the service earlier this month.
Sources also said Bayerische Vereinsbank and Commerzbank AG were among the other banks providing credit for Kirch.
No immediate confirmation of this was available.
